queries_run: FormFactor 10-K supply chain single source supplier Taiwan China risk

findings.claim: FormFactor 10-K 風險因素：依賴單一或有限來源供應商，多數供應商僅採採購單而非長約，單一來源供應商可能漲價拖累毛利
findings.excerpt: Because we rely on purchase orders rather than long-term contracts with the majority of our suppliers, we cannot guarantee our ability to obtain components and materials in the long term. A sole or limited source supplier could increase prices, which could lead to a decline in our gross profit.

findings.claim: 某第三方 PESTLE 分析稱 FormFactor 於 2025 年 11 月宣布在德州 Farmers Branch 投資新先進製造廠，定位為回岸（二手聚合來源，未核公司揭露）
findings.excerpt: FormFactor is aligning its growth with this federal push by investing in a new advanced manufacturing facility in Farmers Branch, Texas. This project, announced in November 2025, is a strategic bet on reshoring.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 將供應商中斷連結到關稅與貿易壁壘、區域緊張
findings.excerpt: This could be exacerbated by certain events outside the control of either the supplier or us, such as global, regional or national health crises, armed conflicts, increased tariffs and trade barriers, regional tensions or other adverse global, regional and national events.

geo_supply_chain.note: FY2025 10-K 提到供應中斷與關稅、區域緊張相關，但未讀頁面核原文；10-K 亦提及加州與中國廠區電力中斷史。未找到具名台灣單點供應商。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
